summary: The diff implements a personalized dashboard for authenticated users with backend Motoko actor changes, React Query hooks, and a DashboardSection component. Most requirements are satisfied. However, one notable gap exists: the backend does not appear to implement stable storage for state persistence across canister upgrades (REQ-2 AC: 'State persists across canister upgrades'), as the userData map uses Map.empty() with no preupgrade/postupgrade system hooks or stable variable declarations visible in the diff.

missing_requirements.reason: The backend uses 'let userData = Map.empty<Principal, UserData>()' with no stable variable declaration or pre/postupgrade hooks visible in the diff. Without stable storage, the userData map will be reset on each canister upgrade.

hallucinated_features.description: URL parameter utilities including getUrlParameter, storeSessionParameter, getSessionParameter, getPersistedUrlParameter, clearSessionParameter, clearParamFromHash, and getSecretParameter for handling admin tokens and session persistence
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request makes no mention of URL parameter utilities, session storage helpers, or admin token handling. The file frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts was added with extensive URL/session parameter management that is outside the scope of the personalized dashboard feature.

hallucinated_features.description: useGetCallerUserProfile and useSaveCallerUserProfile hooks in useQueries.ts referencing getCallerUserProfile and saveCallerUserProfile actor methods
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request only requested hooks for fetching dashboard data (visit count, preferences) and a mutation for updating preferences. Hooks for getCallerUserProfile and saveCallerUserProfile were not requested and do not correspond to any specified backend function.

hallucinated_features.description: useGetPersonalizedDashboard hook exposing a text-based getPersonalizedDashboard query
hallucinated_features.reason: While the backend implements getPersonalizedDashboard, the build request's REQ-3 specifically asked for hooks to fetch user dashboard data (visit count, preferences) and a mutation to update preferences. A separate text-message dashboard query hook was not requested.
